Vehicle strikes crowd at Berlin Pride event, causing casualties

A vehicle drove into a crowd gathered for an LGBTQIA+ event in Berlin, Germany, on July 26, 2026. At least one person was killed and between 15 and 17 others were injured. Police stated the suspect had ties to Islamic circles in the German capital. The incident led to the cancellation of the Berlin Pride parade and an intensive manhunt for the suspect.
